results/hidden_states/probe_plan.json.representation: Train a separate linear probe on the frozen <cls> vector from each saved layer. Do not update transformer weights.

object_location.target: Final effective location of the queried object.

is_carried.target: Whether the queried object has a current carrier.

current_carrier.target: Current carrier of the queried object, including Nobody.

story_length.target: Number of ordered events in the story.

has_distractor.target: Whether any event is outside the queried object's evidence_event_ids.

protocol.standardization: Fit feature scaling on probe-training data only.
protocol.regularization: Choose linear-probe regularization on validation only and use the same candidate values for every layer.
controls: repeat probe fitting with at least three probe seeds
compare identical train/validation/test examples across layers
protocol.interpretation_limit: Probe decodability does not by itself show that the transformer uses the decoded feature causally.

notes.current_carrier: Sanity/readout probe: this is the original training target.
notes.has_distractor: Exploratory: extractor labels use evidence_event_ids and may be confounded with story length. Compare against story_length results.
notes.pca: PCA was fit on standardized training states and applied to test states.

notes: Results were collected from the source files named below; no scores are inferred.
CSV values are preserved as text; JSON reports retain their original types.
Checkpoints, hidden vectors, and images are referenced, not embedded.
Use the recorded configuration to distinguish full runs from quick checks.
